stories.title: 35 people charged federally as part of 'Operation Circle City Shield' in Indianapolis
stories.summary: U.S. Attorney Tom Wheeler announced Thursday that 35 people have been charged with federal firearms, drug trafficking and other offenses as part of the operation.

stories.title: 'His leadership extended beyond City Hall' | Former Richmond, Indiana mayor dies at 96
stories.summary: Former Mayor, Clifford J. Dickman died Nov. 15 at the age of 96. He served as mayor from 1976 to 1983.

stories.title: Delaware County prosecutor finds Muncie officer justified in fatal shooting during standoff
stories.summary: Prosecutor Eric Hoffman said the officer's actions were "completely and legally justified" under Indiana law.

stories.title: 2 Indiana men charged in $600 million Ponzi scheme
stories.summary: Both men were arrested on Wednesday for allegedly luring over 2,000 investors with extraordinary returns while diverting hundreds of millions of dollars.

stories.title: 'Confident' | FBI shares update on deadly Flora fire investigation; $50K reward offered
stories.summary: Investigators ruled the Nov. 21, 2016 fire an arson, saying someone intentionally set the home on fire, killing four young sisters.

stories.title: 66-year-old man dies in tree stand fall in Knox County
stories.summary: Around 2:30 p.m. Wednesday, Knox County officials responded to a report of an unresponsive person near Bruce Road and State Road 67.

stories.title: 53-year-old woman killed, 2 seriously injured in 5-car crash in rural Tippecanoe County
stories.summary: The crash was reported around 4 p.m. Nov. 17 along southbound US Highway 231 around 15 miles south of Lafayette.

stories.title: Westfield Mayor Scott Willis launches reelection campaign
stories.summary: "Looking to the next four years, my focus is on executing the community-driven roadmap more than 6,000 residents helped create," Willis said in a statement.

stories.title: Salvation Army kicks off annual 'Red Kettle Campaign' in Indianapolis
stories.summary: For more than 100 years, the Salvation Army has used the campaign to help Hoosiers in need by providing food, housing, youth programs, and other essential services.

stories.title: Flood relief organizers see growing need for assistance, hope for deadline extension
stories.summary: After reaching out to hundreds of Marion County residents, flood relief organizers hope the state will give families more time to apply for financial assistance.

stories.title: Federal commission approves sale of AES to investment organizations
stories.summary: The federal commission approved the acquisition, which was led by Global Infrastructure Partners, a part of BlackRock and the EQT Infrastructure VI fund.

stories.title: 'Christmas at the Zoo' returns to Indianapolis Nov. 21
stories.summary: Since 1967, Christmas at the Zoo has been a holiday favorite for Hoosiers across the city.
